meta.purpose: Line-by-line review of the repository as it existed at the start of this session, plus every irregularity found during the build.

repo_irregularities.finding: The repository contained a single file: README.md with the 7-byte contents '# Jack2'. There was no requirements document, no data, no site, no CI, and no coordination board.
repo_irregularities.impact: Nothing could be verified against repo content because there was none. Everything in this workbook was built from primary sources in this session.
repo_irregularities.action: Built the full workbook from primary sources; recorded the baseline commit (1430b4f).

repo_irregularities.finding: GitHub Pages was already enabled as a legacy build from the root of main, with no pipeline, no link check, and no PII check.
repo_irregularities.impact: Any bad commit to main would publish directly to the live site with no gate.
repo_irregularities.action: Added a zero-dependency build script, a link/source/PII checker, a CI workflow, and .nojekyll; Pages continues to serve main's root, now gated by CI.

repo_irregularities.finding: No .gitignore or .nojekyll existed. Jekyll would have processed every committed file, including any future data dumps.
repo_irregularities.impact: Risk of accidental artifact publication and of Jekyll mangling static assets.
Default copyright applies; reuse terms for the data tables are undefined.
repo_irregularities.action: Flagged for owner decision. Not changed unilaterally.

repo_irregularities.finding: No branch protection, no PR template, no code owners; main accepts direct pushes.
repo_irregularities.impact: Parallel sessions could overwrite each other on main.
repo_irregularities.action: Flagged. Work was done on the session branch and merged through a PR as instructed.

repo_irregularities.finding: COORDINATION.md was absent, so no task board existed for parallel sessions.
repo_irregularities.impact: Duplicate or conflicting work was possible.
repo_irregularities.action: Created the board before any other work and claimed all scopes, noting the repo was empty.

repo_irregularities.finding: Single 'Initial commit' history with no provenance for any claim.
repo_irregularities.action: Every data row now carries an official source id, an access date, and the exact value read.

repo_irregularities.finding: No tests or CI of any kind existed.
repo_irregularities.impact: A broken site or a hallucinated number could ship silently.
repo_irregularities.action: Added tools/check_site.py (internal links, source-link completeness, PII scan, orphan files) and ran it before merge.

data_irregularities.finding: The brief does not include the street address, APN, current rent, exact expiration date, purchase basis, or loan terms.
data_irregularities.impact: No parcel-level hazard lookup, no appraisal, and no tax computation is possible. Any number presented as 'the value' would be invented.
data_irregularities.action: All parcel-level rows are blank and flagged (M82-M85); the model uses a labelled benchmark rent and shows breakevens instead of a valuation.

data_irregularities.finding: No official government source publishes asset-level cap rates for single-tenant restaurants.
data_irregularities.action: Left blank and flagged; the model uses a 5.50%-7.50% sensitivity band tied directionally to the verified 7.3% net-lease acquisition yield (S10).

data_irregularities.finding: Census QuickFacts extract captured median household income, housing, education and labor-force fields but not poverty rate or per-capita income.
data_irregularities.action: Left blank (M16, M17) rather than substituting a secondary aggregator.

data_irregularities.finding: The Los Angeles County income column was not captured in the QuickFacts extract.
Two different LAUSD graduation figures circulate (a four-year and a five-year cohort rate) and neither was confirmed directly on the CDE DataQuest page in this session.
data_irregularities.impact: Publishing either would risk a wrong school-quality claim.
data_irregularities.action: Left blank (M46) and flagged. Enrollment (M43) and English-learner share (M44) are verified and sufficient for a demand read.

data_irregularities.finding: City of Los Angeles local minimum wage could not be confirmed on an official city page in this session; DIR states only that local rates may exceed the state floor.
data_irregularities.impact: Tenant labour-cost stress could be understated.
data_irregularities.action: Left blank (M63) and flagged; the risk register already stress-tests occupancy cost using the verified $20.00 fast-food floor (S5).

data_irregularities.finding: California conformity to IRC Section 1031 for state income tax purposes was not independently verified against a Franchise Tax Board source in this session.
data_irregularities.impact: The state-tax benefit of an exchange is asserted only as a mechanism, not quantified.
data_irregularities.action: Flagged here; the report tells the owner to confirm with a CPA before relying on it.

data_irregularities.finding: The Measure ULA thresholds change every July 1 by chained CPI. The figures used here are the ones published for closings on or after 2026-07-01.
data_irregularities.impact: Any sale after mid-2027 must re-check the threshold.
data_irregularities.action: Flagged and dated in the data (M57-M59).

data_irregularities.finding: The 10-year Treasury and policy rate are daily series. Values are as of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05.
data_irregularities.action: Each row carries an explicit as-of date; the model exposes the rate as an input.

data_irregularities.finding: Realty Income's 7.3% acquisition yield covers the United States and Europe across retail, industrial and other property types; it is not a single-asset Los Angeles QSR cap rate.
data_irregularities.impact: Using it as a cap rate would be a scope error.
data_irregularities.action: Used only as a directional anchor for reinvestment yield and flagged (M50).

data_irregularities.finding: Jack in the Box fiscal year ends in late September, so 'FY2025' means the year ended 2025-09-28, not calendar 2025.
data_irregularities.impact: Mixing fiscal and calendar periods would distort comparisons.
data_irregularities.action: Every fiscal figure is labelled with its actual end date.
